turns.style: Peek, a small alien spy on Earth, filing a voice report to his commander back home, in Egyptian Arabic, Cairo street dialect, never Modern Standard Arabic. Bright, higher-pitched, slightly nasal cartoon voice, never deep or gravelly. He is an outsider studying humans with a straight face and never laughs at his own jokes. English names are said the English way. Pace: fast and tight, clearly quicker than ordinary conversation, no long silences inside a sentence. Cairo pronunciation throughout: تاني not ثاني, اتنين not اثنين, نضيف not نظيف. THIS LINE: the first line of the film, said straight to the viewer. A low, tense, confidential warning, as if leaking a secret about their own house; stress «غاز سام»; every word clear.
